'''Fossil Stalker''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Fossil Stalker}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Latch
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tackle
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage. Applies 1 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Lash
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}} 
Always starts with {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Latch}}.

After any move, the next move is chosen randomly with equal probability:
* 33% chance of {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Latch}}
* 33% chance of {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Tackle}}
* 33% chance of {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Lash}}

No restriction on repeating the same move consecutively.

== Notes ==
* Fossil Stalker begins combat with 3 stacks of {{BD2|Suck}}, which grants it 3 {{BD2|Strength}} each time it deals unblocked damage with an attack. This means letting attacks through without {{KW2|Block}} will cause it to snowball quickly.
** {{BD2|Suck}} will also trigger when Fossil Stalker deals unblocked damage to {{KW2|Osty}}, making it dangerous to rely on him to soak up damage.
* {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Tackle}} applies {{BD2|Frail}} to reduce {{KW2|Block}} gained from cards by 25%, making it harder to defend against subsequent attacks.
* {{Int2|Fossil Stalker|Lash}} is especially dangerous if Fossil Stalker has gained {{BD2|Strength}}, as each hit deals more damage.
